Hadith.3402 - It is narrated from Al-Husayn ibn Khalid who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan (as), "May I be your ransom!

People say, 'The guarantor (al-damin) is liable (gharim).'"
Imam (as) replied: "There is no liability (ghurm) upon the guarantor.
The liability is upon the one who consumed the wealth."
